card.headline: benfica end omonia's *perfect start*.

highlight.text: Andronikos Kakoullis levelled before half-time. Benfica scored 3 more after the break.

card.footnote:
Omonia: 6 points from 3 games.
Next: N.E.C. Nijmegen v Omonia, Thursday 5 November.

caption:
Benfica beat Omonia 4-1 at GSP in the Europa League, Omonia's first defeat of the league phase. ⚽

Benfica went ahead through an own goal on 14 minutes, and Andronikos Kakoullis equalised on 42. After the break, Vangelis Pavlidis, Fredrik Aursnes and Gianluca Prestianni scored for the visitors.

Omonia still have 6 points from 3 games, after wins over Celta and Celje. Next up: N.E.C. Nijmegen away on Thursday 5 November.

What did you make of it? 🇨🇾
